name: Klaus-Dieter Ziegler
bio:
Klaus-Dieter's journey into motorsport catering began unexpectedly. After culinary school in Munich, a chance encounter with a Rexal FMI Racing team member led to an opportunity to manage their paddock catering. He quickly found a passion for providing top-quality, nutritious meals to the team, understanding that peak performance requires peak fuel. His commitment to excellence and innovative menu ideas rapidly earned him a reputation for being one of the most promising young catering managers in the sport.

Klaus-Dieter believes that catering is more than just providing food; it's about creating a positive and supportive environment for the team. He emphasizes fresh, locally-sourced ingredients and works closely with nutritionists to optimize meal plans for the drivers and crew. Known for his meticulous planning and uncompromising standards, Klaus-Dieter ensures every detail, from presentation to dietary requirements, is perfectly executed. This demanding approach, while sometimes challenging, consistently delivers exceptional results and keeps the team performing at their best.

What sets Klaus-Dieter apart is his unwavering dedication to pushing culinary boundaries within the unique context of motorsport. He's constantly experimenting with new recipes and techniques to enhance flavor and nutritional value, making him a valuable asset to Rexal FMI Racing.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a side part
physical.description: Klaus-Dieter has a focused look, with a sturdy build reflecting his hands-on approach.

quirks: Insists on using only German-made kitchen appliances.
Always carries a small notebook to jot down new recipe ideas.
Meticulously organizes the pantry according to expiration dates and food groups.
